description: Small labeled dataset for evaluating the full matching pipeline with the real embedding model. Each case has a resume text, a job description, and expected behavior: matched/missing canonical skills, score bounds, and a match tier used for the ordering check (strong > medium > weak). Scores depend on the embedding model, so bounds are intentionally loose. Demonstration data, NOT a benchmark.
